## Working of LEFT JOIN

![Left and Right Tables](data:image/png;base64,)

Here,

- The LEFT JOIN keyword joins the Customers and Orders tables.
- The ON keyword specifies the join condition (Customers.customer_id = Orders.customer_id), ensuring all rows from Customers and matching rows from Orders are included.

Let's explore some examples of LEFT JOIN.
